pictures.name: header
pictures.alt: Illustration seen from above: a chalk ring on pavement with a small group of marbles in the middle and a shooter marble at the edge, a dotted line showing its aim.
pictures.caption: A ring, some marbles and a shooter: all you need to start. Illustration.

pictures.name: what-you-need
pictures.alt: Illustration of what you need to play marbles: a few small target marbles, one slightly bigger shooter marble, and a stick of chalk and a piece of string for marking a ring.
pictures.caption: Target marbles, a shooter, and chalk or string to mark a ring. Illustration.

pictures.name: knuckling-down
pictures.alt: Labelled diagram of a hand knuckling down, seen from the side: the knuckles rest on the ground, the marble sits in the bent index finger, the thumb is tucked behind it, and an arrow shows the thumb flicking the marble forward.
pictures.caption: Knuckling down: a knuckle on the ground, the marble in the bent index finger, the thumb behind it. Diagram.

pictures.name: hunching
pictures.alt: Diagram comparing two shots: on the left, marked right, the hand stays still and only the thumb moves; on the right, marked wrong, the hand is pushed forward while shooting, which is the foul called hunching.
pictures.caption: Only the thumb moves. Pushing your hand forward is a foul: hunching in the US, fudging in Britain. Diagram.

pictures.name: lagging
pictures.alt: Diagram of lagging seen from above: two players send their shooters toward a line, and the shooter that stops closest to the line wins the first turn.
pictures.caption: Lagging: whoever stops closest to the line goes first. Diagram.

pictures.name: ring-game
pictures.alt: Diagram of a simple ring game seen from above, in three numbered steps: a shooter fired from outside the chalk ring, a target marble knocked out of the ring, and the shooter stopping inside the ring, where the player shoots again from.
pictures.caption: A simple ring game: shoot from outside the ring; knock a marble out and stay inside, and you shoot again from where your shooter stopped. Diagram.

pictures.name: conqueror
pictures.alt: Diagram of Conqueror: one player tosses a marble onto the ground, the next player shoots at it; a hit captures it, a miss leaves the shooter's marble where it stopped as the new target.
pictures.caption: Conqueror: hit the marble and it's yours; miss, and your marble becomes the next target. Diagram.

pictures.name: hundreds
pictures.alt: Diagram of Hundreds: two players shoot toward a small circle; when only one marble lands inside, that player scores 10 points and shoots again, and the first to 100 wins.
pictures.caption: Hundreds: only one marble in the circle scores 10. First to 100 wins. Diagram.

pictures.name: share
pictures.alt: How to play marbles. Illustrated marbles: a cat's eye, a corkscrew, a clearie and an aggie.
